t1.titulo: Parts of the body and symptoms
t1.descripcion:
🔹 COMMON SYMPTOMS (common symptoms):

PAINS:
• dolor de cabeza = headache
• dolor de estómago = stomachache
• dolor de garganta = sore throat
• dolor de espalda = back pain
• dolor de muelas = toothache
• dolor de oídos = earache
• dolor muscular = muscle pain

OTHER SYMPTOMS:
• fiebre = fever
• tos = cough
• resfriado = cold
• gripe = flu
• náuseas = nausea
• mareo = dizziness
• alergia = allergy
• fractura = fracture
• quemadura = burn
• cortada = cut
• hinchazón = swelling
• moretón = bruise

🔹 RELATED VERBS:
• doler = to hurt
• tener fiebre = to have a fever
• estornudar = to sneeze
• toser = to cough
• vomitar = to vomit
• sangrar = to bleed
• romperse = to break (a bone)

📌 EXAMPLES:
• Me duele la cabeza.
• Tengo fiebre y tos.
• Creo que tengo gripe.

t4.titulo: In the emergency room and health tips
t4.descripcion:
🔹 EN URGENCIAS (emergency room):

• Necesito un médico urgente. = I need an emergency doctor.
• Llame a una ambulancia. = Call an ambulance.
• Ha sido un accidente. = There's been an accident.
• Se ha desmayado. = He/She fainted.
• No respira. = He/She isn't breathing.
• Tiene una hemorragia. = He/She is bleeding.

🔹 CONSEJOS DE SALUD (health tips):

• Coma frutas y verduras. = Eat fruits and vegetables.
• Haga ejercicio regularmente. = Exercise regularly.
• Beba suficiente agua. = Drink enough water.
• Duerma al menos 8 horas. = Sleep at least 8 hours.
• No fume. = Don't smoke.
• Limite el alcohol. = Limit alcohol.
• Lávese las manos frecuentemente. = Wash your hands frequently.

🔹 PROFESIONALES DE LA SALUD:

• médico de cabecera = general practitioner (GP)
• pediatra = pediatrician
• cardiólogo = cardiologist
• dermatólogo = dermatologist
• oftalmólogo = ophthalmologist
• dentista = dentist
• fisioterapeuta = physiotherapist

📌 EJEMPLOS:
• Necesito ver a un médico urgente.
• ¿Dónde está el hospital más cercano?
• Para mantenerte sano, come bien y haz ejercicio.
ejemplos: Necesito ver a un médico urgente.
Para mantenerte sano, come bien y haz ejercicio.

t3.descripcion:
🔹 PHRASES AT THE PHARMACY:

• Necesito algo para el dolor. = I need something for pain.
• ¿Tiene algo para la tos? = Do you have something for cough?
• ¿Es con receta? = Is it prescription?
• ¿Cómo se toma? = How do you take it?
• ¿Cada cuántas horas? = Every how many hours?
• ¿Tiene efectos secundarios? = Does it have side effects?
• ¿Puede darme algo para la fiebre? = Can you give me something for fever?

🔹 TYPES OF MEDICATIONS:

• pastillas / comprimidos = pills / tablets
• jarabe = syrup
• crema = cream
• ungüento = ointment
• inhalador = inhaler
• gotas = drops
• vendas = bandages
• tiritas = band-aids
• analgésico = painkiller
• antibiótico = antibiotic
• antiinflamatorio = anti-inflammatory
• antihistamínico = antihistamine

🔹 COMMON INSTRUCTIONS:

• Tome dos pastillas cada ocho horas. = Take two pills every eight hours.
• Tome una cucharada después de comer. = Take one spoonful after eating.
• Aplique la crema en la zona afectada. = Apply the cream to the affected area.
• No tome más de tres al día. = Don't take more than three a day.

📌 EXAMPLES:
• ¿Puede darme algo para la fiebre?
• Tome dos pastillas cada ocho horas.
• Este jarabe es para la tos.
ejemplos: Necesito una receta para este medicamento.
Tome el jarabe después de comer.
Ponga la crema en la piel dos veces al día.

t2.descripcion:
🔹 DOCTOR'S QUESTIONS:

• ¿Qué le pasa? = What's wrong?
• ¿Dónde le duele? = Where does it hurt?
• ¿Desde cuándo? = Since when?
• ¿Tiene fiebre? = Do you have a fever?
• ¿Ha tomado algo? = Have you taken anything?
• ¿Tiene alergias? = Do you have allergies?
• ¿Toma alguna medicación? = Do you take any medication?

🔹 PATIENT'S ANSWERS:

• Me encuentro mal. = I feel bad.
• Me duele aquí. = It hurts here.
• Tengo fiebre desde ayer. = I've had a fever since yesterday.
• He vomitado dos veces. = I've vomited twice.
• No puedo dormir. = I can't sleep.
• Me siento débil. = I feel weak.
• Me duele al respirar. = It hurts when I breathe.
• Me duele al moverlo. = It hurts when I move it.

🔹 DIAGNOSIS AND TREATMENT:

• Tiene una gripe. = You have the flu.
• Tiene una infección. = You have an infection.
• Le voy a recetar un medicamento. = I'm going to prescribe medication.
• Necesita reposo. = You need rest.
• Tiene que beber mucho líquido. = You need to drink plenty of fluids.
• Necesita una radiografía. = You need an X-ray.
• Tiene que ir al especialista. = You need to see a specialist.

📌 EXAMPLES:
• ¿Desde cuándo tiene fiebre?
• Le voy a recetar un antibiótico.
• Necesita descansar unos días.
ejemplos: Tengo que tomarme la medicina tres veces al día.
El médico me ha recetado pastillas.

dict.昨天我起床时喉咙痛得厉害，还发烧。起初我以为只是普通感冒，但咳嗽不停，全身都疼。: Yesterday when I got up I had a severe sore throat and a fever. At first I thought it was just a common cold, but the cough wouldn't stop and my whole body ached. I decided to make an appointment with the family doctor. In the consulting room, the nurse took my temperature and blood pressure. The doctor asked if I was allergic to any medication and listened to my breathing with a stethoscope. He told me I had a severe flu and needed absolute rest for at least three days. He prescribed cough syrup and fever-reducing tablets. He also advised me to drink plenty of water and not go out. As I didn't improve, the next day I went to the emergency room. There they took a chest X-ray to rule out pneumonia. Fortunately, it was just a viral infection. No ambulance was needed, but I learned to take better care of my body.

dict.在西班牙，国家卫生系统（SNS）为居民提供全民免费医疗。任何人都可以去健康中心预: In Spain, the National Health System (SNS) provides universal free healthcare to residents. Anyone can go to a health center to make an appointment with a family doctor. In emergencies, you can call 112 or go directly to the hospital emergency room. Pharmacies are places where pharmacists give advice and sell medicines; many medicines require a prescription. In addition, the health card makes it easy to access services. The system is a major pillar of the welfare state, funded by taxes.
dict.在中国，医疗体系以公立医院为主，但通常需要先付费后看病，且优质资源集中在大城市。: In China, the healthcare system is mainly public hospitals, but usually you have to pay before seeing a doctor, and quality resources are concentrated in big cities. Spain's universal free healthcare differs from China's basic medical insurance system.

To make /r/, the tip of the tongue taps the alveolar ridge lightly, while for /l/ the tip presses against the alveolar ridge and air passes along the sides. Practice word contrasts like "pero" and "pelo".
